title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：stone　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the farmer ① laid the stone that no child in the field would have counted, and he said the laying was the whole of the autumn. The ② stone, meaning the rock itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed uncounted in the book; a stone, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ stone in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ stone at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the farmer said the counting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stone was the whole of the matter, meaning the weight and not the rock. The ⑥ stone, meaning the weight and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; stone, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a rock and a weight. He said the weight is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ stone had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ stone of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of counting; stone, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stone I remember is the rock counted in the almanac, which closed in 1964 and is still counted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ stone, my mother said in 1966, is the only rock that improves by being counted; every stone, she said, is a weight that has agreed to look like a rock. She said the weight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 石头（指田垄里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 石头（指那块石头本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay the stone 砌这一块石头
D. n. 石头（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 石头之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的石头之事）
F. n. 石头（指农事历里写到、被清点的那一块）
G. n. 石头、分量（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分量（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: laid the stone that no child in the field would have counted
The stone, meaning the rock itself and not the basket
the stone at the far fence
the stone was the whole of the matter

The stone of the whole thing

answers.why: lay the stone 意为“砌这一块石头”，1957 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯清点的一块石头做了一遍。
stone 意为“石头”，指那块石头本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。
stone 意为“石头”，指田垄里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
stone 意为“石头”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stone 意为“石头、分量”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块分量就是那件事的全部。
stone 意为“分量”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块石头，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stone 意为“石头”，指农事历里写到、被清点的那一块，到 1962 年这一块成了农事历里的一行。
stone 意为“石头之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的石头之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的清点。
stone 意为“石头”，我记得的是农事历里清点过的那一块，1964 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一块。
stone 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，石头是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的石头。

那块石头，指的是那块石头本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被清点。（stone）
